name: Hampshire County, MA
findings: Hampshire County has 732 nonprofit organizations. 268 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 230 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hampshire County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 29 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Hampshire County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 153 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Hampshire County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
